messages:
sara: Heads-up — during the eu-west load run I saw ~1% TLS handshake failures on edge proxies after the RBAC tighten yesterday. Error looks like KMS unwrap failing and then cert verify.
sara: Sample log: ```ERROR edge-proxy: tls handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate; unwrap: AccessDenied: User cannot perform kms:Decrypt on key```. 
raj: Ack. Which RBAC change landed? was it the keystore principal scope tighten?
sara: Yes — PR 4129 merged. It scoped keystore access to service account principals only, and removed a wildcard role.
lia: Can we confirm whether this is a new principal name mismatch (service account vs workload identity)?
raj: Checking KMS audit logs now, one second.
auditbot: KMS Audit: 38 UnwrapDenied events in eu-west in last 10m for key alias/edge-keystore. Principal: system:serviceaccount:edge:edge-processor-sa -> denied.
jordan: @taylor-sec @sara if unwrap denied, edge proxy falls back and presents a stale or self-signed cert, so downstream rejects — matches the cert verify errors.
taylor-sec: Possible that the RBAC filter removed the IAM binding that allowed the edge proxy service account to call kms:Decrypt. Do we have the previous binding?
sara: We have a backup snapshot of IAM bindings from 2026-03-20. I diffed it vs current — the binding to role/keystore-unwrap was removed for edge-processor-sa.
raj: Quick mitigation: add a temporary allow for kms:Decrypt for edge-processor-sa and restart canary proxies. If that clears, we know RBAC change is the cause.
lia: +1. Also we should add an audit-only preflight to RBAC CI to run a canary unwrap test against a staging key.
jordan: Command I used to tail logs: `kubectl -n edge logs -l app=edge-proxy -c proxy --since=5m`. Also check `gcloud logging read` for KMS UnwrapDenied entries.
ops-bot: Deploybot: ACL change rollback available: revert PR 4129 (pipeline id 8832) — run `./infra rollback 4129 --env eu-west-canary`.
sara: Rolling back on canary now. Will monitor. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
raj: After rollback, canary proxies show handshake success and KMS unwraps succeed. No new UnwrapDenied events.
auditbot: Audit: KMS UnwrapDenied events dropped to 0 in canary window.
sara: Can confirm resolution on canary. Plan: 1) hold cluster-wide RBAC rollout; 2) emergency revert for prod if needed; 3) follow-up RFC to require IAM-binding diff check in RBAC change PRs + automated KMS unwrap smoke test.
taylor-sec: Also add long-term fix: make policy generator include explicit service account principal names (avoid broad removal), and add a pre-merge check that simulates service account-to-key access.
lia: Filing an incident ticket with timeline and remediation steps now. ticket: INC-2026-1443.
jordan: Postmortem action: add RBAC change checklist item "run KMS unwrap smoke against all regions".
sara: Good catch, thanks everyone. Leaving flags for product teams that own edge-processor SA. :thumbsup:
